offerings.name: Web Search API (/search endpoint)
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results (rounded up per 10 results). Credits are $5 per 1,000 (Hobby), 2,000 (Standard), 2,500 (Growth), 5,000 (Scale).
offerings.price_basis: Hobby（入门付费档，$5 = 1,000 credits）；Search 2 credits/10 results → 1,000 条结果 = 200 credits = $1.00（Standard $0.50、Growth $0.40、Scale $0.20）
offerings.free_quota: Free Plan: 1,000 credits / month，$0/month，500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped；Scrape、Search、Interact 另有无需 API key 的 keyless free tier（按 IP 每日限额）
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（按 web/news/images/alexandria 来源分组，含 url、title、description、position）；可通过 scrapeOptions 返回 markdown、HTML、links、screenshots 等整页内容
offerings.note: 每 10 条结果向上取整计费；gov 分类不额外消耗搜索 credits；企业 ZDR 搜索 10 credits/10 results，匿名 ZDR 2 credits/10 results；启用抓取时另计 1 credit/页。默认返回 Highlights。
